title: Deen-e-Nabi Da Waaris Beywaarisa De Vaangu Pardes Turpeya Ey
body:
Deen-e-Nabi Da Waaris Beywaarisa Dey Vaangu Pardes Turpeya Ey
<<DIVIDER>>
Sehgaye Ey Rondhi Kalli
Khaali Gharaan Ch Sughra
Akbar Vi Na Reya Ey
Pardes Turpeya Ey
<<DIVIDER>>
Turpaye Ney Veer Saarey
Behna Tey Phupiyaan Maavaan x2
Haye Chacha Ghazi Mera
Naavaan Ch Karbala Dey
Kyun Naam Na Leya Ey
Chup Chaap Turpeya Ey
<<DIVIDER>>
Sughra Ey Ro Ro Aakhay
Nana Mey Khaab Takeya x2
Laaray Nu Laa Ke Sehra
Sab Jaanji Roh Rahey Ney
Hoya Inj Da Ik Veya Ey
Ghurbat Di Inteha Ey
<<DIVIDER>>
Keeta Si Jera Wada,
Roz E Azal Mey Nana x2
Sajday Ch Sir Kata Ke
Naalay Chaadaran Luta O
Poora Eh Hogaya Ey
Nayi Mera Koyi Reya Ey
<<DIVIDER>>
Sab Kalmago Ey Vekho
Zibh E Azeem Karbal x2
Akhan Tay Nayi Ai Pattiyan
Akbar Dey Dil Chon Barchi
Shabbir Kadd Ria Ey
Khamosh Qibriya Ey
<<DIVIDER>>
Shahid Khayal Aiho
Rovan Laye Ey Kafi x2
Akhian Chon Khoon Ronda
Keevien Badshah E Ghairat
Bazar Lang Gaya Ey
Zainab Vi Berida Ey
